0022600020.text: The Miami Heat, hosting at home, are 1-4 on the season and 0-3 at home, sitting 13th in the East and fifth in the Southeast, 2 games back, while on a 1-4 stretch over their last ten games. The Indiana Pacers come in at 2-3, 10th in the East and third in the Central, 2 games back, and are on a two-game losing streak after going 2-3 over their last ten. Six Pacers are unavailable: Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Obi Toppin (back soreness), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and the teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, after the Heat lost 1-2 in the 2025-26 series, including a 135-118 loss in Indianapolis in their most recent meeting.
